posts.title: The Death of Rabelais by Jane Clark Scharl
posts.description: Friar: Humor’s a relief! It shows the truth.Every Laugh’s a window on the void—crack jokes with me, and by them crack the world’sfacade to show the bedlam underneath!…Rabelais: Humor is no chaos, but the verydrip and flow of everything, the stickyfluid carrying life up from stodgysoil to all these many moistening bodies…humor is our unity, […]
